Spot Award, Capri Global Capital (2025).
personalInfo.skills: Java, Python, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Drools, Apache Kafka, JUnit, Microservices, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, AWS (S3, Lambda), Grafana, Loki, Jenkins, Selenium, Playwright, LangChain, RAG, MCP

highlights: Production incident RCA agent (LangChain, RAG, on-prem LLM, MCP/Jira) correlating Loki logs and Kafka errors across Spring Boot services — ~40% lower MTTD on P1/P2.
Drools rules + Spring Boot APIs for loan credit decisioning; JUnit health checks and regression for 500+ applications/month.
Multi-product compliance reporting (Python, Grafana/Loki, AWS S3, Jenkins) for CapriLoans, Capri Home Loans, and WhatsApp — ~8 hours saved per cycle.
Selenium calling-data reconciliation and Playwright regression/smoke suites across UAT and production.
